params.caption: 🎮 Logitech gives all 7,000 staff a day off to play games — GTA 6 included The peripheral maker has launched a "Logi Game Day" initiative: every employee gets one dedicated day off, usable any time over the next year, to play a game of their choice. That includes GTA 6, the game everyone is talking about. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 18:55 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware #Logitech #GTA6 #GamingNews
